novelty.justification: The core claim is that the trait is "linearly encoded in the student's weight update" and that its identity and strength can be recovered by projecting that update onto a teacher-derived trait direction, making the novelty route a weight-space measurement of subliminal transmission. Searches using "subliminal learning weight delta teacher trait direction cosine," "parameter update alignment predicts trait transfer," and "weight-space audit subliminal learning" identify the closest work as Channel Location Constrains the Auditability of Subliminal Learning (2026), which already reports that the cosine between a student distillation update and the teacher's fine-tuning displacement predicts held-out transfer; Ilharco et al.'s Editing Models with Task Arithmetic (2023) supplies the broader task-vector precedent. Replacing the initial-update alignment in that 2026 work with the student's final fine-tuning delta, plus matched-direction classification, is a natural extension of the same setting, measurement, and mechanistic relationship rather than a new core insight.
